description: Source code for LPC (Linear Predictive Coding) functions used in AMR speech codec, including initialization, reset, exit, and LPC computation functions.

methods.name: lpc_init
methods.description: Initializes the LPC state data, allocates memory, and sets up sub-states.

methods.name: lpc_reset
methods.description: Resets the LPC state data, particularly the Levinson state.

methods.name: lpc_exit
methods.description: Frees the LPC state data and deallocates memory.

methods.name: lpc
methods.description: Performs LPC analysis for GSM AMR, computing predictor coefficients based on input signals and mode.
